notes.title: DEMO AVAILABLE NOW! And No Time To Loot Fest!
notes.content: [p]Hello! Thank you for showing interest in my indie game, Discard All Hope! A quick shoutout and thank you to Human Qube and their[url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45063983/view/510715993771737586?l=english"] No Time to Loot Festival[/url], if you found this game through that fest, I'd love to hear about it in the comments![/p][p][/p][h2][b][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4020390/Discard_All_Hope__Demo/"]Check out the demo HERE![/url][/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]If you are new , Discard All Hope is:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A "twin stick" shooter (it does support Mouse and Keyboard though)[/p][/*][*][p]An Action RPG with an emphasis loot.[/p][/*][*][p]A deckbuilder.[/p][/*][*][p]Placed in a late Gothic Victorian horror setting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668724/f6ae117b964c7d76ff1ca63794bb961faf63d8fb.png"][/img][/p][p]Discard All Hope is a particularly good fit for the No Time to Loot festival as it's all about looting new spells for you deck of cards. These cards act as both attacks/abilities, [u]but also function similarly to equipment by boosting your passive stats[/u] and affecting your elemental resistances.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45668724/2b52f468b4f059cde4f73c673ee67ecd1ba793cc.png"][/img][/p][h1][/h1]
